'''Teha Zero''' founded the [[Cybernetics/Legends|cyberneticist]] cult known as the [[New Men]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] sometime before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Zero advocated the merging of man and machine, and foresaw a future where everyone lived in peace because scarcity and physical limitations would be non-existent. However, when Zero [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Codex" /> sometime before [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> her protege [[Bezar One]] took over the cult and turned it into a pro-[[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] terrorist group.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Teha Zero was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the New Men in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
